title: Nonparametric Estimation of Matching Efficiency and Mismatch: An Application to Japanese Labor Markets
abstract: arXiv:2407.20931v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I identify significant biases in the traditional Cobb-Douglas function under misspecification of nonadditive, time-varying matching efficiency, and evaluate the finite-sample performance of the nonparametric estimation method of Lange and Papageorgiou (2020). Additionally, I extend the mismatch index by Sahin et al (2014) to a nonparametric framework and develop a computational methodology. Applying the method to Japanese labor market data from government surveys and Hello Work, I analyze changes in matching efficiency, elasticities, and mismatch. Both datasets show declining matching efficiency, aligned with decreasing job-finding and vacancy-filling rates. The unemployment elasticity is around 0.5-0.9 in the Hello Work data and lower in the nationally representative aggregate, while the vacancy elasticity is higher in the nationally representative aggregate. translated_title: 匹配效率与错配的非参数估计：在日本劳动力市场中的应用
translated_abstract: 本文识别了在非可加、时变匹配效率被错误设定的情况下，传统柯布-道格拉斯函数存在的显著偏差，并评估了Lange和Papageorgiou（2020）非参数估计方法的有限样本表现。此外，我将Sahin等人（2014）提出的错配指数扩展到非参数框架，并开发了相应的计算方法。将该方法应用于来自政府调查和Hello Work的日本劳动力市场数据，我分析了匹配效率、弹性和错配的变化。两个数据集均显示匹配效率在下降，这与求职率和职位填补率的下降相一致。在Hello Work数据中，失业弹性约为0.5-0.9，在全国代表性的总体数据中则较低，而职位空缺弹性在全国代表性总体数据中更高。此外，我证明了职业错配比（摘要原文在此处不完整）
tldr: 本文将匹配效率估计与错配指数扩展至非参数框架并应用于日本劳动力市场数据，发现匹配效率持续下降，且职业错配程度比传统柯布-道格拉斯方法估计的更为严重。
en_tdlr: This paper extends matching efficiency estimation and the mismatch index to a nonparametric framework, applying it to Japanese labor market data and finding declining matching efficiency along with more severe occupational mismatch than traditional Cobb-Douglas methods suggest.
